product_metadata.title: Fennco Styles Toscana Handmade Hemstitch Contemporary Linen Blend Table Runner for Dinner Table, Picnic Table, Parties, Wedding Decorations, Exhibitions, Natural, 16 x72 Inch
features: MATERIAL --- High quality, exquisite and soft, made of 20% linen and 80% polyester, a healthier and more comfortable choice for your home.
DESIGN --- A single hemstitched border brings a clean and classic aesthetic to this table runner. The fabric and style gives off an old world charm, and can be used daily or for entertaining.
MULTI-PURPOSE UTILIZATION ---- Multi-size for choosing, suitable for dinner table, folding table, patio table, indoor/ outdoor parties, restaurants, weddings, everyday use and more.

BEST GIFT ---- Makes a great hostess gift for daily use, family and friends’ dinner or parties and give as a gift for table décor such in Mother's Day, wedding decorations, housewarming or any other causal/ formal occasion.
EASY TO CLEAN --- Machine washable. Use warm or cold water, low temperature drying. Please follow care instructions to minimize shrinkage.
